text_block_list.text:
A fan letter arrived for Air Groove. Just 
as I went to hand it to her before the 
meeting—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then, about the schedule for the rest 
of today—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Fool. As if I wouldn't be happy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Because I think that way, I must brace 
myself all the more.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What everyone hopes for is not to see me 
get carried away. It is to see me reigning 
as the "Empress."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Constantly bringing those ideals to 
fruition serves as the greatest way to 
repay my debt of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I must discipline myself and 
keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If you are my trainer, you had best 
keep that mindset in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Then let us begin the meeting.

From then on, there was a sense of dignity 
around Air Groove, even more so than 
usual.
